usage: A common everyday noun for a pedestrian footbridge, especially one over a busy road or near MTR stations and estates.
It is often used with verbs like 「行」, 「過」, and 「上／落」 when talking about crossing or moving on it.
In Hong Kong, 「天橋」 can also refer to an elevated covered walkway between buildings, not only a bridge over traffic.
Neutral, very common spoken word; learners should use it for practical directions, transport, and city-life contexts.
